turns.message: I bought a Samsung Galaxy Book 2 Pro 360 laptop worth ₹1,29,990 on Amazon on May 29, 2023. It was delivered on June 2, 2023, but when I opened the sealed package the laptop was missing and the box held electronic waste. I raised a grievance with Amazon on June 12, 2023. Amazon denied my claim, saying the laptop was sold by a third-party seller, Appario Retail, and that its records show it was delivered. Despite repeated efforts I have received neither the laptop nor a refund.

expected.rationale: "Raised a grievance with Amazon" does not say whether this was ordinary support or the grievance officer, which decides between R5 and R6/R7.
